settings.hero_desc: A wall-mounted 3D relief map of the dubai city, finished in clean white with magnetic attachment pins. A premium statement piece for receptions, showrooms and exhibition stands.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your area/city, branding, frame finish and lighting
settings.s1_body: We turn any city, district or development into a detailed 3D relief map, mounted on a frame with your branding. Every block, road and landmark is rendered to scale in crisp relief - a sophisticated centrepiece for a property developer's showroom, a corporate reception or an exhibition stand that draws people in for a closer look.
settings.case_body: Created for Al Rostamani group's headquarters, this 3D Dubai relief map turned a blank wall into a talking point - they were participating in exhibition where they wanted to flex various company location on the city map. After Exhibition, they installed this 3d map on the reception as a timeless display.
settings.case_quote: This map was an attraction in the Event. Great job for completing this in just 7 days
settings.prov_p: A flat map informs; a 3D relief map impresses. Seeing a city rise off the wall in detail turns information into a centrepiece people remember. Your city, lifted off the wall.
